The executed implementation reduces both training inputs and labels to 10,000 observations before fitting. This is a contradiction in the reported baseline training quantity, not an allegation that its predictive scores were invented.

The three VNNGP records have RMSE 5.1101295061, 5.0983111597 and 5.0998446980, matching the saved predictions and the rounded reported mean. Their provenance does not support the reported 500000-observation training size.
